newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle brisk at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle brisk at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady.
Inquiry good, demand fair. Sales confirmed on 20,400 slaughter steers and 21,300 slaughter heifers Tuesday.
For the week to date 104,900 head confirmed including 15,400 head or about 15 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1275 lbs 64.00. Dressed basis - few Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 103.50-104.00 hot weights, delivered.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 975-1125 lbs 64.00; pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1050-1250 lb heifers and heiferettes 62.50. Dressed basis - few Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 103.50-104.00. Confirmed - 41,700
